verdict.rationale: Elastic's own docs say the product offers data retention with tiered storage, which touches the retention half of the story. Nothing documents user-configurable retention periods, lifecycle policies, or data deletion. The logs@custom template mention is too indirect to count. missing for 10: documented user-configurable retention periods/lifecycle policies, explicit data deletion or purge controls, privacy-oriented deletion guarantees, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: offers scalable, cost-efficient data retention with tiered storage
